item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.18 (36)
- Reclaim Disk Space: after you quit an app with the Quit button, its locked caches unlock on their own; lock cards and the Storage Map name the open apps; the Trash step offers Full Disk Access when it needs it; "Empty Only Reclaim's Items…" says exactly what it empties; Guide Me says when the Trash is already empty and offers Select Recommended only when there is something to select. - Redundancy & Clutter: remembers your folders, size floor and checks between launches; says before a scan which checks can move files and afterwards what could not be read; Select All Except Keepers with a counted confirmation; Overlapping Folders keeps one name and states its size floor; Level and Risk sort by severity. - Uninstall an App: a counted Find App Leftovers confirmation with its size; drafts can be removed from All Uninstall Sessions; All Apps offers Resume or Open and searches by name; Kept Items says why each item was kept; blocked uninstalls and failed Put Backs are explained instead of holding up Finish. - Keep Mac Awake: "Also Hold Off Screen Saver" now reliably keeps the screen saver and the lock screen from starting. - Blocker Alerts: a fixed-size settings window with colored status, idle times up to 1 hour, and a topic field that accepts a bare topic ID. - Status menu: every main-menu row shares one height, and the hover highlight no longer overlaps trailing text and glyphs. - Scroll Speed and Pointer Speed: two devices with the same name (for example two "USB Receiver"s) both stay listed, so the dialog no longer disables itself. - AI Usage: Claude sign-in keeps its credential under XHelpers Pro's own keychain access, so the repeated keychain approvals are gone and existing accounts move over on their next refresh; a token renewal that stalls before anything is sent now waits for the network instead of asking you to reconnect in the browser. - Updated translations in all 25 supported languages.
